title: Use or Possession of Drug Paraphernalia
key_points: Using or possessing with intent to use drug paraphernalia to ingest, inject, inhale, store or prepare CDS (not cannabis).
elements: The suspect used, or possessed with intent to use, drug paraphernalia
To plant, grow, manufacture, test, pack, store, contain, conceal, inject, ingest, inhale or otherwise introduce CDS into the body (not cannabis)
